> 第 25章 曾经辉煌（第1页）
就在几名地精风骑士登上天空，面见姜尤之时。
蒙恩平原的大地上，地精营地的中央，十几名人族坐在一处钢铁铸成的奇艺造物旁。
一名金色短发的中年男子看着天空上庞大的翼人军团，眼眸中涌现出一丝怀念。
“想当年，帝国也拥有着比这支翼人部落强大万倍的空中军团！”
“同样背负着羽翼，翱翔天际，九大空中军团之一的天奏者军团比这些翼人们更加肃然！”
金发的美丽女孩翻了翻白眼，叹道。
“可惜，这些都已成过往，帝国早已经灭亡，我们现在要做的，不过是让人族再次生存在这片大地上，不至于绝了种。”
“若真是那样，可就太对不起帝国为守护这个世界而做出的牺牲了！”
黑发的人族男子显然也认同，他问道。
“菲奥娜，你接触过天上的那位翼人王，怎么样，有没有可能成为我们的助力！”
“他知晓一些隐秘，但也不多。他似乎想让我相信他也是我们那个时代的人，通过一种叫做“转生”的手段重生在了翼人身上！”
“这可真是，离了个大谱！哪怕当年帝国最强的巫师序列强者，也难以做到这样的事情！”
“的确如此，但我选择“相信”，这位翼人王，看来也是想要从我们这里获取好处啊！”
“这是好事，菲奥娜。就怕他无欲无求！”
“正因如此，他才有争取的可能。”
“杨爷爷，这名翼人王自称是那个时代的东方人族，这段时间，你去想办法接触一下吧！”
“你这丫头，还真是让人闲不得。”
“行，我便去接触一下他。看看他想要什么。”

“嗯，早知道，当初就应该把觉醒的时间设置的早一些，现在被地精拿捏，真是让人难以接受！”
“其实也不能这么说，若不是地精巧合地撞破了我们设置的密锁。再过一万年，我们可能就再也醒不过来了！帝国的辉煌，可就真的湮灭在时间的长河中了！”
“您看，我们曾经那么多避难所，如今真正还存在的还有那些？”
为首的地精骑士对着姜尤恭敬行礼。
“尊敬的翼人王，我王阿米格尔已经为贵族准备了驻地和一应粮草。”
姜尤顺着地精骑士的所指的方向看去，果然看到了在地精营地的旁边，有一处干净整洁的营地，上面摆放了不少粮草和装备。
看来地精很重视翼人，阿米格尔是个好人啊！
似乎看出姜尤的神态很满意，地精骑士继续说道。
“尊敬的翼人王，今日太阳落下之时，还请您在带领族人安顿好后，便来我王的中央大帐中一趟。”
“我王想要同各族领袖，商讨讨伐泰坦巨人的具体事宜！”

> Chapter 25 Once Glorious (Page 1)
Just when several goblin wind knights ascended to the sky to meet Jiang You.
On the land of Men's Plain, in the center of the goblin camp, a dozen or so humans were sitting next to a strange and artistic creation made of steel.
A middle-aged man with short blond hair looked at the huge winged army in the sky, with a trace of nostalgia in his eyes.
"I think back then, the empire also had an air legion that was ten thousand times more powerful than this winged tribe!"
"Also carrying wings and soaring into the sky, the Skywalker Legion, one of the nine air legions, is more solemn than these winged people!"
The beautiful girl with blond hair rolled her eyes and sighed.
"Unfortunately, this is all in the past. The empire has long since perished. What we have to do now is just to let the human race survive on this land again and not become extinct."
"If that's the case, I'd be so sorry for the sacrifices the empire has made to protect this world!"
The black-haired human man obviously agreed, and he asked.
"Fiona, how is it that you have come into contact with the Winged King in the sky? Is it possible for you to be our helper?"
"He knows some secrets, but not many. He seems to want me to believe that he is also a person of our time, reborn in the body of a winged man through a method called "reincarnation"!"
"This is really, really out of the ordinary! Even the strongest wizard in the empire back then would have been hard-pressed to do such a thing!"
"That's true, but I choose to 'believe' that this Winged Man King seems to want to gain benefits from us!"
"This is a good thing, Fiona. I'm just afraid that he will have no desires or desires!"
"Because of this, he has the possibility to fight for it."
"Grandpa Yang, this King of Wings claims to be an Eastern human race of that era. During this time, you should find a way to get in touch with him!"
"You girl, you really don't want to be idle."
"Okay, I'll go get in touch with him. See what he wants."
"Well, if I had known earlier, I should have set the awakening time earlier. Now that the goblins are taking advantage of me, it's really unacceptable!"
"Actually, you can't say that. If the goblins hadn't accidentally broken the secret lock we set up, we might never wake up again in another ten thousand years! The glory of the empire will really be lost in the long river of time!"
"Look, we once had so many shelters. Which ones still exist today?"
The leading goblin knight saluted Jiang You respectfully.
"Dear Yiren King, my king, Amiguel, has prepared a residence and a supply of food and grass for the nobles."
Jiang You looked in the direction pointed by the goblin knight, and sure enough he saw a clean and tidy camp next to the goblin camp, with a lot of food, grass and equipment placed on it.
It seems that the goblins attach great importance to the winged people, and Amiguel is a good person!
Seemingly seeing Jiang You's expression of satisfaction, the goblin knight continued.
"Dear Yiren King, when the sun sets today, please come to my king's central tent after you have led the tribe to settle down."
"My king wants to discuss the specific matters of conquering the Titans with the leaders of various tribes!"
